name: Kazakhstan
shortSummary: Kazakhstan anchors India's "Connect Central Asia" policy and supplies uranium for India's civil nuclear programme; India hosted the first India-Central Asia Summit in 2022.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Kazakhstan is a key source of uranium for India's nuclear power generation.
Founding participant in this regional engagement framework launched in 2022.
